You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.

Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ A woman, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan catches you eyeing the bark plates — claw-scored, vine-laced. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They talk you through it — wide strips dried flat, laced overlapping like shingles, snug but not tight. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
"Hey." A woman, maybe 30s settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A woman, maybe 30s.)
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.

Travel 1 tile to trail edge.
— An old trail —
Where the trail crosses bare rock, someone scratched a mark — an arrow, or a tally, or a prayer. Pre-Burn. You add nothing. You remember it.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan telling A man, maybe 40s, with a broad frame about Logan. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

Travel 2 tiles to grove.
— Nut trees —
Hickories and oaks, heavy with mast. This is a pantry that grows.
Movement — a waddling porcupine, quills rattling softly.
👁 Never grab it barehanded. A bow works clean; hands get quills. Flip it with a long stick if you must.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

Travel 2 tiles to creek.
— Moving water —
The creek braids around gravel bars. Crawdads flick backward into the shadows of rocks.
Something moves out there — the humming in the grass.
Movement — a broad flat-tailed beaver, working the bank.
👁 The tail-slap ends the hunt — it dives and warns the whole creek. Strike before the tail rises, or trap the slide.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
